title: Integer multiplicity slices of τ(M, θ, ξ) by a Lipschitz function: co-area mass bound and averaged boundary identity (Simon Ch. 6, 4.1–4.5, integrated form)
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U A B : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → A ⊆ B → B ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (B ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict A), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1)) (RT : IMRep U (n + 1)) (RB : IMRep U n) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), IsOpen U → RT.Represents T → RB.Represents T.boundary → LipschitzWith L f → ∃ Rs : ℝ → IMRep U n, (∀ t, (Rs t).carrier ⊆ f ⁻¹' {t}) ∧ (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet W → AEMeasurable (fun t => (Rs t).measure W) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (Rs t).measure W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * RT.measure W) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Integrable (fun s => (Rs s).action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n))) ∧ ∀ (ω : TestFormOn U n) (a b : ℝ), a < b → ∫ s in a..b, (Rs s).action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = (b - a) * ((∫ x in RT.carrier, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * min 1 (max 0 ((b - f x) / (b - a))) * RT.orient x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n + 1]) - ∫ x in RB.carrier, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * min 1 (max 0 ((b - f x) / (b - a))) * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n])
